items.title: Spider Exploring a Leaf
items.alt: One spider uses a front leg to hold a small magnifying glass above a broad fallen leaf, seven other legs clearly visible.
items.description: One spider uses a front leg to hold a small magnifying glass above a broad fallen leaf, seven other legs clearly visible. Useful for observation activities.

items.title: Spider Playing a Small Drum
items.alt: One spider holds two short drumsticks with its front two legs, six legs supporting its body beside one small drum.
items.description: One spider holds two short drumsticks with its front two legs, six legs supporting its body beside one small drum. Useful for rhythm activities.

items.title: Spider at a Xylophone
items.alt: A spider reaches two front legs toward two mallets over a small five-bar xylophone, six other legs spread behind it.
items.description: A spider reaches two front legs toward two mallets over a small five-bar xylophone, six other legs spread behind it. Useful for music story prompts.
